This product combines 30mg of Niacin, 300μg of Biotin, 10mg of Vitamin B1, 50μg of Vitamin B12, 15mg of Vitamin B2, 10mg of Vitamin B6, 25μg of Vitamin D, 15mg of Vitamin E, 100μg of Selenium, 20mg of Zinc, 425μg of Folate, 350μg of Iodine, 50mg of Pantothenic acid as labelled amounts. Why this product

  • Once a day (1 tablet): 30mg Niacin, 300μg Biotin, 10mg Vitamin B1, 50μg Vitamin B12, 15mg Vitamin B2, 10mg Vitamin B6, 25μg Vitamin D, 15mg Vitamin E, 100μg Selenium, 20mg Zinc, 425μg Folate, 350μg Iodine, 50mg Pantothenic acid

  • Made by (주)오투바이오

  • Niacin
    • Needed for energy production in the body
    • Needed for energy production

    • Needed for energy production

  • Vitamin B2
    • Needed for energy production in the body
    • Needed for energy production
  • Vitamin B6
    • Needed for protein and amino acid utilisation
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
  • Vitamin D
    • Needed for the absorption and utilisation of calcium and phosphorus
    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of bone
    • Recognised as helping reduce the risk of developing osteoporosis
  • Vitamin E
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Selenium
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Zinc
    • Needed for normal immune function
    • Needed for normal cell division
  • Folate

    • Needed for energy production
